hints.content:
The first term is $0.2$ and the common ratio is $-5$.

| $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times (-5)\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times (-5)\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times (-5)\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | |
:-: |  :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$0.2,$ | | $-1,$ | | $5,$ | | $-25,...$

This is the recursive formula of $0.2\,,-1\,,\,5\,,-25,...$.

$\begin{cases}
a(1)=0.2
\\\\
a(n)=a(n-1)\cdot(-5)
\end{cases}$
